corrections.reason: Smudged ink in the middle of the word caused the standard Amharic negative verb 'አይሆንም' ('this cannot be, for does the Lord despise a tax collector/sinner?') to be garbled as 'አችምይሆን'.
The 6th-order sadis 'ን' in singular 'ቢያጥን' (referring to King Uzziah entering the temple to burn incense) was misread as 2nd-order 'ኑ'.
The 4th-order rabi 'ካ' in 'ካስተማሩት' (from what they taught him, parallel to L09 'ካስተማርናችሁ') was misread as 1st-order 'ከ'.

corrections.reason: The Ethiopic numeral 30 ('፴') was misread as the visually similar CJK character '卅'.
